author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

This PR extends the `deepCopy` method of the PortableCollections to allow copying from a larger collection to a smaller. In this case all elements up to the size of the smaller collection are copied from the larger collection. The copy would look like this:
```c++
smallCollection.deepCopy(queue, largeCollection.const_view());
```
The deepCopy method works heterogeneously which means that the two collections can live in different memory spaces like device and host. Also the methods works for SoABlocks. In this case every block can have a size smaller or equal to the size of the input collection.


#### PR validation:

Purly technical, Unit tests have been extended to test the extended functionality

FYI @slava77 @felicepantaleo
title: Allow smaller input collections for DeepCopy
